description: One Robinhood Chain token at the three moments, read from the chain now. The code pass (clean code, not clean, unread): verified source, launcher template, owner privileges, transfer-tax code, honeypot flags. The activity pass (passes, fails, not judged): the code again plus sells clearing, the pool not drained, the deployer share, the holder concentration tier. The size (sized $X, not sized): a share of the pool by tier when the entry test clears, with the one reason when not. verdict.moments carries the three with their reasons; verdict.key keeps the 0.3 word (ELIGIBLE, NOT_ELIGIBLE, FAIL, UNVERIFIED), mapped in verdict.keys. Computed under a named, dated ruleset (the optional ruleset argument) and marked beta; the facts are measured and timestamped. Jev probabilities as context when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set. signals: the research triggers this scan crosses right now (hosted server; conditions that held up in later data, each with its n and dates), evaluated on the scan's own facts and never written; the verdict and the size do not change for a trigger. Research only, not financial advice.

address.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex characters).

requestId.description: Hosted server only, optional: your own id for this call (the same as the X-Request-Id header). A retry with the same id, wallet, tool and arguments is answered from the first charge: the saved answer when there is one; "retry shortly" (-32000) while the first execution still holds its 120-second lease; a free re-run once the lease has lapsed with no answer (the retry then owns the execution). The same id with different arguments is refused. An answer too large to keep is re-run free on replay.

ruleset.description: Which ruleset the verdict is computed under. A preset name (keelage-default; "default" is short for keelage-default), or { lines: [{ key, value }] } to replace lines of keelage-default. Keys are the ones in keelage_record's rules: top10.conviction, top10.scout, pool.deep, size.poolShare, deployer.max, holders.min, entry.midPump, entry.minVolume24h, entry.minTurnoverOfMcap, entry.deepPoolTurnover, entry.convictionBelowPeak, liquidity.maxDrawdown, base.atBase, base.justOff, base.wellOff, jev.halveBands, sweep.minAgeDays, sweep.minPoolUsd, sweep.poolFloorUsd, sweep.minMcapUsd, sweep.maxMcapUsd, size.poolShare.scout, activity.triggerVolume24h, watch.minMcapUsd, watch.sixHourlyMcapUsd, watch.hourlyMcapUsd. The facts never change; only the policy over them does. Omitted: keelage-default.

value.description: A number, or for a band line an array of numbers of the same length as the default.

signature.description: Hosted server only: proof that you control the wallet, needed to spend prepaid credit. personal_sign (EIP-191) of the message "Keelage credit <your address, lower case> <YYYY-MM-DD UTC> chain 4663 mcp.keelage.ai" with the wallet's key; the same as the X-Wallet-Sig header. Good for its UTC day only.

wallet.description: Hosted server only: your wallet address (0x + 40 hex), the one that paid. The same as the X-Wallet header; the argument wins when both are sent. Priced calls past the free 20 a day draw on its credit, and every priced answer carries a credit line (credit: this call's price and where it was paid from, the free calls left today, the balance).
